reason.provider: Not available for models of this provider.
reason.model: This model does not support it.
reason.automatic: The provider does this automatically for this model; there is nothing to set.
reason.not_mapped: The provider has a similar feature, but Nodestro does not offer it as this option yet.
reason.unknown: It is not documented whether this model supports it.

nativeTool.provider: {{tool}}: not available for models of this provider.
nativeTool.not_integrated: {{tool}}: the provider offers such a tool, but Nodestro does not use it yet because its fees cannot be priced and limited.
nativeTool.capability: {{tool}}: this model cannot use the provider's own tools.

thinkingBudget.label: Thinking budget (tokens)
thinkingBudget.hint: How many tokens the model may spend on thinking before it answers. Empty: the model decides. 0 turns thinking off where the model allows it. Thinking tokens count against Max. tokens.

limits.unknown: The model's maximum output is not documented; the provider decides.

settings.title: Model output limits
settings.intro: How many tokens Nodestro's own AI steps may answer with. Leave a field empty to use the default. Agents set their own limit in the agent editor (Max. tokens).
settings.budgetNote: The limit includes the model's thinking. A higher limit allows longer answers but never bypasses a budget: the cost check reserves exactly this value before each request.
settings.modelMaximum: Assistant model {{model}}: at most {{tokens}} output tokens.
settings.modelMaximumUnknown: The maximum output of the assistant model {{model}} is not documented; values are sent as set.
settings.invalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
settings.perModel: {{tokens}}, at most the maximum of the model used

reduced.model_maximum: Lowered to the model's maximum output.
reduced.context_window: Lowered to half of the model's context window.

settings.retry: Retry answers that were cut off
settings.retryHint: When an answer of the Workflow Architect reaches its limit, ask once more with a doubled limit (at most the value below and the model's maximum). The retry is sent only if its full cost fits into the job's remaining budget.
settings.fixInvalid: Some values are outside the allowed range ({{min}} to {{max}} tokens). Correct them to save.
